description: Convert volume between litres, gallons, cubic feet, fluid ounces, cups, tablespoons and more. One input shows every unit at once.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a US gallon and an imperial gallon?
faqs.a: A US gallon is 3.78541 litres; an imperial (UK) gallon is 4.54609 litres. This converter uses the US gallon, which is standard in most recipes and fuel figures.

faqs.q: How many millilitres are in a US cup?
faqs.a: One US legal cup is 240 ml; the customary US cup used in cooking is 236.588 ml, which is what this converter uses.

faqs.q: Are cubic meters and litres related?
faqs.a: Yes — 1 cubic meter is exactly 1,000 litres, and 1 litre is exactly 1 cubic decimetre.
